description: Registered instruction-cache transactions and frontend control: matched model results, rejected physical routes, and accepted-hardware baseline.
source_notes: ce5da4b merges upstream main 7b7af54 while retaining the FPGA memory-fault and multiplication paths.
fetch-boundary-upstream-div17 snapshots an uncommitted intermediate based on ce5da4b; its source HEAD label and file hashes are preserved in its manifest. It is not attributed to 72b5b58.
72b5b58 registers complete instruction-cache data/tag/valid write events and adds pending transaction forwarding.
528c986 registers port cancellation/flush, tags queue generations and supports atomic local-request replacement while lower bus transactions retain ownership until drained.
7916e34 adds checked Linux application workloads and documentation; it does not change528c986 RTL.

6ec10fa removes an unnecessary atomic-trigger operand mux/effective-address dependency, with matched simulation results unchanged. Both its normal route and bounded postroute refinement fail setup timing.

42ae42a separates multiply/divide cancellation validity from private datapath reset. Its normal, bounded postroute and incremental routes all fail setup. Arithmetic, cycle equivalence, cancellation/restart, matched CoreMark, memory-wait and Linux shell checks pass.
5a127b6 adds cancellation/restart regression coverage without changing 42ae42a RTL.
